$comment: Single source of truth for tier -> model routing in omp-dev-team. The `model-routing` extension and the /model-routing-check command read this file. Agents declare a tier in their `model:` frontmatter: small-tier agents use `pi/smol` (resolved by .omp/config.yml modelRoles.smol, defaulting to a LOCAL model); reasoning-tier agents pin a concrete cloud model id. Only the small tier is local by design -- local models replace the cheap pattern-matching agents, not Sonnet/Opus.

haiku.rationale: Lexical/structural pattern matching, checklist-style verification (naming, complexity, a11y, svelte, js-fp, token-efficiency, claude-setup, progress-guardian). Cheap, high-volume, parallel. Routed to a local model on the GPU.

sonnet.rationale: Semantic analysis with balanced cost/quality (most team agents + most review agents + orchestrator).

opus.rationale: Cross-file reasoning, high-stakes design synthesis, threat modeling, broad reconnaissance (security-review, domain-review, arch-review, architect, security-engineer, codebase-recon).

local.rationale: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (a.k.a. Qwen3-Coder-Flash): 30.5B total / ~3.3B active MoE. On a 9950X + 64GB RAM + 5070 Ti 16GB it does not fully fit VRAM, but as an MoE it offloads expert FFNs to CPU/RAM and keeps attention + KV on the GPU, so it stays fast (~20-40 tok/s) while being clearly smarter than a 14B dense model. Ollama auto-offloads and is auto-discovered by OMP. For the best throughput on the 30B, run it under llama.cpp with --n-cpu-moe (see alternatives).

alternatives_notes.llama.cpp/qwen3-coder-next: 80B total / ~3B active MoE (hybrid Gated DeltaNet + attention, 256K ctx), SWE-bench Verified ~70.6%. ~40GB Q4 -> fits 64GB RAM. Best quality. Needs a recent llama.cpp build. Run: scripts/setup-local-models.sh --next
alternatives_notes.ollama/devstral: Devstral Small 2 (Mistral, 24B dense), SWE-bench ~72% but narrowly SWE-tuned. ~14GB Q4 -> full-VRAM, best throughput. Run: scripts/setup-local-models.sh --devstral

local.notes: Tier sizing for 16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM: (1) ollama/qwen3-coder:30b = best quality, MoE expert offload, recommended. (2) ollama/qwen2.5-coder:14b Q4 (~9GB) = fully in VRAM, max throughput for parallel review fan-out. (3) llama.cpp/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b with `--n-cpu-moe N` or `-ot '.ffn_.*_exps.=CPU'` = max speed on the 30B. If the local backend is unreachable, the `model-routing` extension blocks small-tier dispatches; set modelRoles.smol: claude-haiku-4-5 to run fully on cloud.
